positions.summary: The PCF programme on pcf.fr (proposition 125) says indirect taxes such as VAT will be cut, not raised. The PCF social-security booklet (Dec 2025) says moving social-security funding from employer contributions onto taxes shifts the burden onto households, and it defends financing through cotisations. Social VAT is the opposite of both.

sources.date: 2026 (page live 5 Oct 2026; programme text partly dates from 2022)
sources.quote: 125 - Les impôts indirects, tels que la TVA et la taxe intérieure de consommation sur les produits énergétiques, seront réduits

sources.outlet: PCF, Les cahiers thématiques des Jours heureux - Sécurité sociale
sources.quote: visant à faire basculer la contribution des entreprises vers le budget de l'État, c'est-à-dire sur les impôts des ménages.

positions.nuance: Neither source names 'TVA sociale', but both reject its two parts: they want VAT cut, and they defend employer contributions as the way to fund social security. Both are PCF party documents promoted as the 2027 candidate's programme, not a personal Roussel interview.

positions.summary: As a deputy, Roussel voted against the whole projet de loi pour le plein emploi at first reading (10 Oct 2023). That law created the 15-20 hours of activity required of RSA recipients. No 2025-2026 promise to abolish the obligation was found.

sources.quote: L'ensemble du projet de loi pour le plein emploi (première lecture). CONTRE

positions.nuance: He opposed creating the obligation, but no abolition pledge was found, so this is -1 rather than -2. The PCF programme on pcf.fr (proposition 42) wants to open the RSA to under-25s and eventually replace it with a guaranteed job or training scheme.

positions.summary: No statement by Roussel or the PCF on making naturalisation easier was found. The PCF programme (proposition 89) promises to regularise undocumented workers, which is a separate measure.
positions.nuance: The draft's +1 was unsourced, and the adjacent evidence points both ways: the party supports regularising workers, while Roussel has personally called for France to be 'plus ferme' on migrant workers (2023). Left uncoded rather than guessed.

positions.summary: The PCF programme (proposition 88) commits to fighting ethnic profiling by bringing in a receipt for each identity check.

sources.date: 2026 (page live 5 Oct 2026; text from the 'Jours heureux' programme, originally 2022)
sources.quote: Les contrôles au faciès seront combattus, grâce à la mise en place du récépissé justifiant qu'une personne a déjà été contrôlée.

positions.nuance: This is the programme currently on the PCF site, whose wording comes from 2022. No 2025-2026 personal statement by Roussel was found. He takes a more security-focused line than the rest of the left, so the confidence stays at medium.

positions.summary: The PCF peace-and-defence booklet for the 2027 campaign (May 2026) attacks the EU's militarisation and the €800bn 'Rearm EU' plan. It criticises the Lisbon treaty for strengthening the EU's military side and calls for French defence independence and leaving NATO. Only limited European cooperation, for example on satellite positioning (geolocation), is accepted.

sources.outlet: PCF, Les cahiers thématiques des Jours heureux - Paix & défense nationale
sources.quote: Les 800 milliards de dépenses militaires supplémentaires décidés par l'UE sont destinés à enrichir les marchands de canons et constituent une nouvelle étape dans l'escalade guerrière.

sources.outlet: PCF, Les cahiers thématiques des Jours heureux - Paix & défense nationale
sources.quote: l'acceptation des traités européens qui renforcent le volet diplomatique et militaire de l'Union européenne, notamment depuis le traité de Lisbonne

positions.nuance: The booklet accepts targeted European cooperation and wants a European defence industrial and technological base, but it rejects any loss of French military autonomy. It is a party document, not a Roussel interview.

positions.summary: The PCF's 2026 peace booklet blames Ukrainian leaders who worked to integrate Ukraine into the 'euro-atlantic' bloc for part of the war's origins, and it calls a Ukrainian military victory 'utopian'. In March 2024 Roussel voted against the government declaration on the Franco-Ukrainian security agreement. No explicit 2025-2026 statement on Ukraine's EU accession was found.

sources.outlet: PCF, Les cahiers thématiques des Jours heureux - Paix & défense nationale
sources.quote: ont remis en cause le multilatéralisme des relations internationales de l'Ukraine et agi pour intégrer le pays à l'ensemble euro-atlantique.
DÉCLARATION DU GOUVERNEMENT SUR LA STRATÉGIE D'AIDE À L'UKRAINE ... CONTRE

positions.nuance: Inferred from adjacent positions. 'Euro-atlantic' refers mainly to NATO, and the March 2024 vote was on a security agreement rather than on EU accession. In November 2022 he voted for the resolution supporting Ukraine. Needs a direct statement.

positions.summary: The PCF programme (proposition 62) promises a farm law to guarantee base prices that pay for farmers' work. Prices would be set for each product at a yearly conference of producer organisations, the government and supermarket buying groups, and selling at a loss would be banned.

sources.quote: Elle aura pour objectifs de garantir des prix de base rémunérateurs du travail paysan
Celle-ci devra déterminer les prix par production, interdire les reventes à perte

positions.nuance: The wording dates from the 2022 programme still on pcf.fr (it refers to 'En 2022'). No newer statement by Roussel personally was retrieved.

positions.summary: The PCF programme (proposition 58) sets VAT on electricity and gas consumption at 5.5%. For motor fuels, the September 2026 campaign proposals are to cap the price at €1.60 a litre and lower state taxes. Proposition 125 cuts VAT and the fuel excise (TICPE) without naming a rate.

sources.quote: la TVA sur les consommations sera fixée à 5,5 %, les taxes assises sur des taxes seront supprimées.
bloquer les carburants à 1,60 euro le litre, baisser les taxes prélevées par l'État et nationaliser TotalEnergies et Engie, aux côtés d'EDF.

positions.nuance: Partial match: 5.5% is explicit for electricity and gas, but for fuels only a tax cut and a price cap are promised, with no 5.5% VAT rate. Hence +1.

positions.summary: No specific statement on France Télévisions or Radio France was retrieved. The PCF programme calls for ending the privatisation of public services and for creating a large Ministry of Culture, Popular Education and Media.

sources.quote: il convient de mettre fin aux dynamiques de concurrence, de privatisation, de réduction des effectifs et de coupes budgétaires

positions.nuance: Inferred from the party's general opposition to privatising public services, with nothing specific to public broadcasting found. The direction is very likely, but the confidence stays low.

positions.summary: On 4 June 2024 Roussel, then a deputy, voted against the amendments deleting Article 5 of the end-of-life bill, the article that created assisted dying. That suggests he supports the principle. No 2025-2026 statement on keeping or repealing the 2026 law was found.

sources.quote: L'amendement de suppression n° 50 de M. Bazin ... à l'article 5 du projet de loi relatif à l'accompagnement des malades et de la fin de vie ... CONTRE

positions.nuance: The vote was on the 2024 bill, which lapsed at the dissolution, not on the 2026 law. He was no longer a deputy when the 2026 law passed. +1 rather than +2 because there is no explicit commitment to keep the law.

positions.summary: The PCF programme (proposition 33) explicitly abolishes selection at university entry and scraps Parcoursup. The baccalauréat would guarantee a place in the chosen higher-education course.

sources.quote: 33 - La sélection à l'entrée de l'université sera supprimée
il garantira une place dans une formation choisie dans l'enseignement supérieur.

positions.nuance: The proposal ends selection itself, not only the Parcoursup platform, so it matches the statement in full. The wording dates from the 2022 programme still on pcf.fr.

positions.summary: The PCF housing booklet (Dec 2025) acknowledges the tension between ZAN and the housing shortage. It keeps the ZAN target: its answer is public control of land, plus densification so that construction stays compatible with the rules against building on new land.

sources.outlet: PCF, Les cahiers thématiques des Jours heureux - Logement
sources.quote: Ces PLUI permettront la densification des opérations de logements publics pour rendre compatible la production avec les règles de non-artificialisation des sols

positions.nuance: The booklet blames speculation on land, not ZAN or building standards, for the shortage. It does not explicitly campaign against loosening the rules, so this is -1.

verification_notes: Context: WebSearch was also exhausted for this verification pass (200/200). Everything below comes from pages opened directly: pcf.fr programme pages (objectif_2/3/4/6, moyen_1), PCF thematic booklets (PDFs on assets.nationbuilder.com), the pcf.fr fuel article of 30 Sep 2026, Datan roll calls and French Wikipedia.
